title: Critical misses view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from DetectionQualityService.critical_misses for an explicit time window, using current recorded dispositions. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Empty misses do not establish clean coverage or a detection rate.

window.description: Explicit timezone-aware time window. Core enforces start before end; JSON Schema validates the individual RFC3339 timestamps only.

title.description: Raw untrusted finding title, preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

reason.description: missed denotes an actual miss; area_reported requires adjudication.

validity.description: Recorded validity, including arbitrary historical strings; null is unknown.
